summary: QA + regression for CR-2026-10-09-002 (coupon Apply wiring), CR-2026-10-09-003 (CRM loyalty caps), and CR-2026-10-03-004 B+C (CRM swap + customer-lookup retirement). All three CRs tested on ReviewOrder.jsx at restaurant 689, customer 9035133228 (saurav, Gold, 2000 pts). Backend smoke+contract: 60/60. Frontend: all verifiable tests PASS.

test_results.CR003_T1_loyalty_format_CRM: PASS: Loyalty row shows 'Use up to X pts (₹Y off)' format from CRM. Not old format. Use button enabled.
test_results.CR003_T2_use_remove_loyalty: PASS: Tap Use → loyalty-points-applied-row shows 'Using 1 points (-₹3)', Grand Total drops. Tap Remove → inline row restored.
test_results.CR002_T1_apply_SEED_EDGE_STACKABLE: PASS: coupon-applied-row shows 'SEED_EDGE_STACKABLE — ₹1 off'. Toast 'Coupon applied — ₹1 off'. Grand Total drops from ₹11.00 to ₹10.00.
test_results.CR002_T2_invalid_BADCODE999: PASS: coupon-error-text shows 'Invalid coupon code: BADCODE999'. Input stays editable. Apply re-enabled after error.
test_results.CR002_T3_remove_coupon: PASS: Remove button click → coupon input row reappears, Grand Total restores.
test_results.CR002_T4_non_stackable_auto_remove: NOT_TESTED: No non-stackable coupon code available in preprod CRM seed data. Code path verified via code review (handleApplyCoupon: !stackable && isUsingPoints → handleRemovePoints() + toast).
test_results.CR002_T5_loyalty_blocks_non_stackable_co: NOT_TESTED: Same reason as T4. Code path verified: handleUsePoints: appliedCouponCode && !couponStackable → toast.error('Remove coupon first to use points') + return.
test_results.CROSS_FEATURE_both_discounts: PASS: SEED_EDGE_STACKABLE (₹1) + loyalty (₹3) both applied. subtotalAfterDiscount = 10 - 1 - 3 = ₹6.00 ✓. CGST ₹0.15, SGST ₹0.15 (tax on discounted base) ✓. Grand Total ₹7.00 (₹6.30 unrounded) ✓. total_round=Yes causes ceil().
test_results.CR004_T2_loyalty_earn_preview_CRM: PASS: LoyaltyRewardsSection uses maxRedeemable?.projected_points_earned (CRM-sourced, not client-calculated). UI shows 'Add ₹190 more to earn points' from CRM.
test_results.T6_full_order_placement: PASS: Order #015059 placed at ₹11. Order success page shows 'Order Placed!' with Bill Summary.
test_results.T6_full_order_with_coupon_placement: PASS (from iteration_14): Order #1233019 with coupon applied at ₹10. coupon_discount_amount > 0 in payload verified.

known_limitations: T4/T5 (non-stackable coupon guard): Could not test because no non-stackable coupon code is available in preprod CRM. SEED_EDGE_STACKABLE has stackable_with_loyalty=true. FLAT TODAY has CRM whitespace bug. Code path for non-stackable guard is correct per code review.

CRM rate-limiting (429): CRM /scan/auth/lookup enforces a per-IP rate limit. Multiple fresh browser sessions in quick succession trigger 429, causing degraded guest mode. Auth requires waiting ~60s between sessions.

math_verification.coupon_only: itemTotal=10, couponDiscount=1, subtotal=9, CGST=0.23, SGST=0.23, totalToPay=9.46, roundedTotal=10.00. Correct.
math_verification.no_discount: itemTotal=10, subtotal=10, CGST=0.25, SGST=0.25, totalToPay=10.50, roundedTotal=11.00. Correct.
